title: Auto-Renew Turned Off but Subscription Renewed Anyway
agent_context: Customer says auto-renew was turned off but they were still charged, creating a trust issue. Verify timestamps vs renewal cutoff, explain outcome clearly, process refund if eligible, and confirm auto-renew is OFF to prevent future charges.

raw_content.initial_message: I had turned off auto-renew last week and you still charged me today.
raw_content.context: Customer claims auto-renew was disabled before renewal but was still charged. Policy: verify account and timestamps; explain billing cutoffs if any; if system error, refund authorized; prevent future renewals; do not argue.

learning_objectives: Verify timestamps to determine refund eligibility
Stop future charges and set a clear resolution path
correct_sop_steps: Check disable timestamp vs renewal cutoff

sticky_notes: HINT: Confirm next billing date is safe.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if auto-renew is OFF, timestamps explained, and refund plan shared
